repair_scope.reason: V1 incorrectly used calendar year(time)-1 as the chick-season key, conflicting with the earlier outcome-blind frozen PALMER_CHICK_SEASON_KEY_RESOLUTION_V1 contract.
repair_scope.objective_prior_rule: The prior frozen season-key contract requires season_start_year parsed from study_name PALYYZZ, positive chick-dataset adult-pair eligibility, consecutive-season validation, and fail-closed duplicate handling.
only_changes: Use study_name PALYYZZ rather than calendar date to assign chick season.
Require finite positive chick-dataset num_breeding_pairs, matching the earlier frozen key contract.
Fail closed on duplicate island + raw colony_code + study-derived season keys rather than resolving them post hoc.

exposure_boundary.consequence: No result from V2 may be described as fully preregistered or outcome-blind. V2 is an auditable provenance repair followed by fixed-specification validation.

inherited_provenance_contract.season_start_year: Parse YY from PALYYZZ; YY >= 90 maps to 19YY and YY < 90 maps to 20YY; validate ZZ is the following year modulo century.
inherited_provenance_contract.duplicate_rule: After five-island, finite positive chick-dataset adult-pair eligibility and study-derived season assignment, fail closed on duplicate island + raw colony_code + season.

paper_role: mechanistic Palmer extension; not a rescue analysis for Paper 2

season_and_join_rules.adult_season: calendar year of November breeding-pair census
season_and_join_rules.chick_row_eligibility: five focal islands; finite num_breeding_pairs > 0; finite num_chicks >= 0; parseable and consecutive PALYYZZ study_name
season_and_join_rules.adult_size_source: independent November adult census breeding-pair count

performance_state.eligibility: island-season with at least 3 matched colony codes, positive island total adult pairs, positive island total chicks, and finite nonnegative colony chick counts
performance_state.standardization: Within each eligible island-season, z-standardize the Pearson residual across matched colony codes; call this S_i,t.
performance_state.interpretation: Relative reproductive performance conditional on contemporaneous group size and shared island-season conditions.

redistribution_outcome.colony_growth: G_i,u = log1p(adult_pairs_i,u+1) - log1p(adult_pairs_i,u) for adjacent annual censuses only
redistribution_outcome.relative_growth: Within each island and transition u -> u+1, subtract the mean G across eligible colony codes; call this R_i,u.
redistribution_outcome.prior_size_control: Within each island-transition risk set, z-standardize log1p(adult_pairs_i,u).

model.form: R_i,u = beta_k * S_i,t + gamma * z_log_size_i,u + island:colony_code fixed effect + error, where u = t + k - 1
model.estimation: OLS separately for each lag on complete matched rows
model.inference: Within predictor island-season, permute S_i,t among eligible colony codes and refit the same model.

direct_replication_endpoint.role: Replication/extension only; mechanically coupled because S_i,t and the t->t+1 outcome share the t adult census.

primary_bias_resistant_endpoint.decision: beta_2 > 0 and one-sided within-island-season permutation p <= 0.05
primary_bias_resistant_endpoint.interpretation: Fixed-specification evidence that relative reproductive state predicts later within-island redistribution without sharing the predictor-year adult count with the growth denominator.

delayed_recruitment_echo.inference: Use synchronized within-island-season permutations across all five lag models in each Monte Carlo replicate.
delayed_recruitment_echo.decision: C_recruit > 0, one-sided p <= 0.05, and at least one of beta_4 or beta_5 > 0.
delayed_recruitment_echo.interpretation: A positive delayed contrast would be compatible with a local cohort/natal-recruitment echo; it is not a unique public-information signature.

secondary_sensitivities.exclude_litchfield: Repeat P1 lag-2 and P2 recruitment contrast excluding LIT.
secondary_sensitivities.minimum_prior_size: Require adult_pairs at outcome interval start >= 2.
secondary_sensitivities.low_chick_effort: Exclude predictor island-seasons with total chicks < 10.
secondary_sensitivities.leave_one_island_out: Report beta_2 and C_recruit after removing each island.

decision_matrix.beta1_only: Known-type one-year association replicated; do not infer persistence beyond shared-denominator transition.
decision_matrix.beta2_supported: Dynamic performance state predicts later redistribution under the bias-resistant endpoint.
decision_matrix.recruitment_echo_supported_only: Lag profile is more compatible with delayed local cohort recruitment than an immediate-only pattern.
decision_matrix.beta2_and_recruitment_echo_supported: Both short-term state dependence and delayed recruitment may contribute.
decision_matrix.neither_supported: Do not promote public-information or cohort-echo explanations for Palmer concentration.

literature_and_claim_boundaries: Do not claim first evidence of public-information use in Adelie penguins.
Do not claim that dynamic state replaces topography, snow or geomorphology.
Do not infer individual movement, prospecting, settlement decisions or causal cue use from colony counts alone.
Do not call a 4-5 year lag a public-information signature.
Do not tune lags, metric, exclusions, alpha or model after this repair.
Paper 2 macro-scale negative results remain negative; this is a separate Palmer mechanistic extension.
